name: TeamStarWolf - Threat Group: Sandworm Team (G0034)
description: ATT&CK-documented techniques attributed to Sandworm Team (G0034; aliases: ELECTRUM, Telebots, IRON VIKING, BlackEnergy (Group), Quedagh, Voodoo Bear, IRID). Sourced directly from MITRE's intrusion-set to technique 'uses' relationships in the bundled ATT&CK v16 data - this is MITRE's own attribution, not a curated TeamStarWolf mapping. Every row is documented group use (score 100). Absence of a technique does not mean the group cannot use it; it means MITRE has not documented it.
